scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your head snaps back, blood flying as your cheek is sliced to the bone, barely missing your eye.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Blinded] (1) and @Condition[Bleeding] (1). The resulting scar will be impressive without being disfiguring, gaining you +1 SL on any Intimidate Test against a target likely to be frightened by such things. You can only gain this benefit once.
